ei.title: Chapter 1-01 2번: Follow-up on a Printer Proposal
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Dear Mr. Harrison, Yesterday I was going through our files and realized that we had neglected to contact you regarding our proposal to replace your office printer. I realize that four months have passed since I sent you the information, so I have attached our original proposal. I hope you will take the time to review it. We feel that our prices are very competitive and that the quality and durability of our printer will actually save you money in the long term. I will call you next Monday after you have had time to review the proposal. I look forward to doing business with you. If you have any questions or concerns, I can be reached at 308-555-9847. Best regards, Sarah Thompson Sales Manager

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Harrison, Yesterday I was going through our files and realized that we had (A)[managed / neglected] to contact you regarding our proposal to (B)[replace / repair] your office printer. I realize that four months have passed since I sent you the information, so I have attached our original proposal. I hope you will take the time to review it. We feel that our prices are very (C)[competitive / expensive] and that the quality and durability of our printer will actually save you money in the long term. I will call you next Monday after you have had time to review the proposal. I look forward to doing business with you. If you have any questions or concerns, I can be reached at 308-555-9847. Best regards, Sarah Thompson Sales Manager
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 연락하는 것을 소홀히 했고(neglected), 프린터를 교체(replace)하자는 제안이며, 가격이 매우 경쟁력 있다(competitive).
det.analysis:
✅ ① neglected — replace — competitive — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② managed — replace — competitive (A 변경: 소홀히→관리)
❌ ③ neglected — repair — competitive (B 변경: 교체→수리)
❌ ④ neglected — replace — expensive (C 반대: 경쟁력 있는→비싼)
det.tip: neglected(소홀히 하다) ↔ managed(관리하다), competitive(경쟁력 있는) ↔ expensive(비싼)

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Harrison, Yesterday I was going through our files and (A)[forgotten / realized] that we had neglected to contact you regarding our proposal to replace your office printer. I realize that four months have passed since I sent you the information, so I have (B)[attached / removed] our original proposal. I hope you will take the time to review it. We feel that our prices are very competitive and that the quality and (C)[durability / fragility] of our printer will actually save you money in the long term. I will call you next Monday after you have had time to review the proposal. I look forward to doing business with you. If you have any questions or concerns, I can be reached at 308-555-9847. Best regards, Sarah Thompson Sales Manager
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 연락을 못 한 것을 깨달았고(realized), 원래 제안서를 첨부했으며(attached), 프린터의 내구성(durability)이 돈을 절약해줄 것이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① forgotten — attached — durability (A 변경: 깨달았다→잊었다)
❌ ② realized — removed — durability (B 반대: 첨부→제거)
❌ ③ realized — attached — fragility (C 반대: 내구성→취약성)
✅ ④ realized — attached — durability — 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 프린터 교체 제안(proposal)에 관해 연락하지 못했고, 원래(original) 제안서를 첨부했으며, 장기적으로 돈을 절약(save)할 것이다.

❌ ① complaint — original — save (A 변경: 제안→불만)
❌ ② proposal — revised — save (B 변경: 원래→수정된)
✅ ③ proposal — original — save — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ proposal — original — waste (C 반대: 절약→낭비)
